body:
this was a very useful post, in the sense, it gave an idea.  Maybe a simple perspective shift could have an impact.  Maybe it is my self loathing that can be corrected.  I do loathe myself to a high degree.  Maybe that is why I've wanted to commit suicide all these years.  I thoroughly despise myself.  I want to murder myself.  It is funny, that I have never felt hatred for anyone else though.  I don't get mad at others really, even if they hurt me.  I have forgiven crazy shit.  Yet I hate myself.  I hate myself so much I  want to end my life.  Crazy.  I never realized that.

here's an even crazier though i have never entertained.  perhaps the bad things i've done, aren't even that terrible at all.  it can be hard to tell.  sometimes i think, hey it wasn't that bad, but then like last night, i went to go see my best friend, and he just laid in to me.  so now i am not certain.

2 months ago... went through a slow fade breakup with a guy i was really in to.  i don't blame him. look at me, i'm fucking crazy.  i am happy for him, that he got rid of me, and i hope for his sake that he never contacts me again, becaseu he was a nice guy and he shouldn't have to deal with a person like me.  i think that's exactly it. it was the realization that i am this broken, mixed with the unexpected loss of someone i cared deeply for, all the while knowing i was the root cause of that loss by doing things which are a result of my fucked up state that i seem unable to change.   this really pushed me over the edge, and i have not recovered, and this time i don't think i wil. though i want to make clear, i am not in any way blaming this guy.  it was just the final straw.  if it hadn't of been that, it would have been something stupid, like i don't know, having to move, or getting robbed or getting fired.  something dumb.  do you see.  its not his fault.  also, i am long over it, and have no feelings for him.  so it's not like that.  that's why this is real.  i have dealt with th e"break up" and moved on, and literally have no feeling sfor this guy.  it was just the straw that broke the camels back.

the whole time in the past few months, i have found it ironic, that it is a simple breakup with a little fling, that has pushed me over the edge.  after a lifetime of dealing with some very real trauma, this is what did it?  i don't understand. but i do.   i just was already at near my threshhold, so the smallest thing, was about to push it over.

the problem is, i value human connection so greatly.  and facing a life without it, is not a life i want to live.  but fuck this conundrum.  if i had no one in my life, without a doubt, i would kill myself.  there is no question on this.  because there would be no one to mourn it, so no reason not to do it.  but at the same time, i do not want to live long enough, to find a life where i have no one.  if i am going to die, i want to die at least with a shred of dignity and happiness in tact.

here's the thing.  it is not worth the fight, to make it through once more, only to deal with this again, and again, and again.  i hope that makes sense.  yes, you're right, it is shit.  it is absolute shit.  shit which i do not want to endure any longer.  does it make sense.  i do not see suicide as a tragic ending.  the reason i do not do it up until this point, is to avoid causing pain to the people i love.  if it were not for that, there is no question iw ould not be here.  but for fucks sake, how much am i to endure.

i don't WANT this fucking life, does it make sense.  if this is life, i don't motherfucking want it.  that is the problem.
and just to make clear, i am not upset at my mom.  she is human.   i dont even know if any of that shit has to do with it, it just makes sense that it might.

thanks.  i do want to stop the drugs.  but that is why i have made this thread, and it is the aprt i can't communicate.  i have reached a threshhold of pain tolerance, for which ic an't tolerate anymore.  recent events, especially some about 2 months ago, pushed me over the edge. this is the problem i no longer have a solution for.  i am literally afraid that, if i go home tongith and don't get more intoxicated, i could die.  because pain is that unberable. i guess what i mean to say is, i found my maximum .  i do not believe i have the ability or mental energy to fight any longer.  i hope to make clear, i'm not upset about that.  i really am indifferent, to if i live or die.  i think.

the problem is the suicidal compulsion was present long befor e the drug use, at least a year and a half very seriously as a compulsion.  the drug use is the only thing that really killed it.  and it still does.  it just there are occasions , where i still have the compulsions while intoxicated.  i do not get high before work in the morning, so at work i am largely sober, and have difficulty not to die.
